-- First-run confirmation belongs to this installation, not portable domain data.
-- Additive: preserve all existing owners, sessions and application rows.

migrations.name: 0005_identity_providers.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Identity providers (OpenID Connect). Apply as a NEW numbered migration after
-- the accounts schema. Every statement is IF NOT EXISTS, so a store that applied
-- an earlier version of this file applies the current one again as its next
-- migration and gains only what it lacks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions_expiry ON oa_oidc_transactions(expires_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_limits (
  bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- One pinned link per configured provider. Linking stores the issuer, JWKS URI,
-- client id, endpoints and allowed algorithms; a changed configuration only
-- records a pending re-link, which the owner completes with a step-up proof.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_providers (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('linked','unlinked')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  jwks_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  algorithms TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_iss INTEGER NOT NULL,
  interface_version TEXT,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_issuer TEXT,
  pending_client_id TEXT,
  pending_preset TEXT,
  pending_at INTEGER,
  jwks TEXT,
  jwks_fetched_at INTEGER
);
-- Reachability per configured provider, linked or not. A provider that has
-- failed discovery or JWKS for 5 minutes, or answered 404 or a DNS failure, is
-- hidden from the sign-in page until a later check succeeds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_provider_health (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  hard_failure_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- Apply after operator-auth.sql as a new numbered migration. Never prune this ledger.
CREATE TABLE oc_owner_claims (
  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
  jti TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  installation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  consumed_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(consumed_at<expires_at),
  operator_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(completed IN (0,1))
);
CREATE TRIGGER oc_owner_claim_empty_store BEFORE INSERT ON oc_owner_claims
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_bootstrap) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_operators)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'owner_claim_already_initialized');
END;

migrations.name: 0014_owner_signin.sql
migrations.sql:
-- One-time owner sign-in links minted by `rer signin` with the deployment's own
-- Cloudflare credentials, written straight into this table through the D1 API.
-- Apply as a NEW numbered migration under the seed's next unused number; never
-- rewrite an applied migration. Additive only. token_hash is the SHA-256 of the
-- link token (owner-signin-grant.mjs); the token itself is never stored.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_owner_signins (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id), operator_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, consumed_at INTEGER
);

migrations.name: 0015_command_receipts.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Refresh-safe writes (command-receipts.ts): one row per actor and form command
-- key. A seed applies this as its next numbered migration; archives leave it out.
CREATE TABLE rer_command_receipts (
  actor TEXT NOT NULL,
  command_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  command TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('running','done')),
  result TEXT,
  once TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(actor, command_key)
);
CREATE INDEX rer_command_receipts_created ON rer_command_receipts(created_at);

-- One row per distinct human approver of one immutable earnings-run version.
-- The row binds the exact content digest, the approver's grant version, role and
-- native session. Release rechecks every binding; nothing here moves money.
CREATE TABLE env_run_approvals (
 company_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind='earnings-run'),
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 approver_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id), role TEXT NOT NULL,
 grant_version INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 content_digest TEXT NOT NULL, debit_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
 occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL, change_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 PRIMARY KEY(company_id,run_id,version,approver_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(company_id,kind,run_id,version) REFERENCES env_workspace_versions(company_id,kind,object_id,version)
);
CREATE TRIGGER env_run_approvals_update BEFORE UPDATE ON env_run_approvals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_run_approval'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER env_run_approvals_delete BEFORE DELETE ON env_run_approvals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_run_approval'); END;
